newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-SRI LANKA RETAINS RANATUNGA AS CAPTAIN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SRI LANKA RETAINS RANATUNGA AS CAPTAIN.

text.p: Sri Lanka has retained Arjuna Ranatunga as captain for its forthcoming tours of India and the West Indies, the Board of Control for Cricket said on Thursday.

Ranatunga will captain the teams to play a quadrangular one-day international series in India in May and tour the West Indies for two tests and one one-day international in June, it said in a statement.
Pakistan and New Zealand are the other teams in the quadrangular tournament in India.
Pakistan is currently touring Sri Lanka for a two-test series. The first test ended in a draw on Wednesday. The second test is scheduled to begin on Saturday.
